scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --workspace=@codemind/react && npm run build --workspace=@codemind/electron
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:backend
scripts.clean: node -e "['desktop/react/dist', 'desktop/electron/dist', 'backend/dist'].forEach(p => require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
